headlines.title: Intuit (INTU) Following New AI Rollout, Is The Growth Story Already Priced In
headlines.summary: Intuit (INTU) has pushed further into artificial intelligence by rolling out new Intuit Intelligence capabilities and detailing its multi year growth plan, a combination that has sharpened attention on the stock. The recent AI announcements have landed at a time when Intuit’s share price has surged in the short term but remains under pressure over longer periods. The stock has a 30 day share price return of 23.24%, while the 1 year total shareholder return has declined 49.

headlines.title: Avalara Launches Nexus Report for Intuit QuickBooks® Online Users
headlines.summary: Avalara, Inc., the agentic AI leader in global tax and compliance, today announced the launch of the Avalara Sales Tax Readiness Report, a no-cost standalone web application available to Intuit QuickBooks® Online users via the QuickBooks App Store.

headlines.title: Black Ore Unveils Robust Tax Automation for Small Firms
headlines.summary: Black Ore for Small Firms lets a 20-person firm take on more clients without adding headcount, with native integrations into Intuit tax software systems.Las Vegas, NV, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Black Ore, the AI platform for financial services, today launched Black Ore for Small Firms, a version of its Tax Autopilot platform built for small and mid-sized accounting practices. The announcement was made at Intuit Connect in Las Vegas.

headlines.title: Intuit Expands Intelligence Platform to Power the Next Era of Accounting Firm and Business Growth
headlines.summary: LAS VEGAS, October 27, 2026--Intuit Inc. (Nasdaq: INTU), the global financial technology platform that makes TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, Mailchimp, Intuit Enterprise Suite, and Intuit Accountant Suite, today announced a wave of new innovation fueled by Intuit Intelligence, Intuit’s unified platform that delivers intelligence and automation that is transforming how businesses and accountants work together.

headlines.title: Intuit vs. BILL: Which Financial Software Stock Is a Better Buy Today?
headlines.summary: INTU offers scale and diversification, while BILL brings faster growth, AI-driven automation and a lower valuation. Which financial software stock wins?

description: Intuit Inc. provides financial management, payments and capital, compliance, and marketing products and services in the United States. The company operates in two segments: Global Business Solutions and Consumer. Its Global Business Solutions segment provides QuickBooks services, which include financial and business management online services, desktop software, payroll solutions, time tracking, merchant payment processing and bill pay solutions, checking accounts, and financing services for small and mid-market businesses; and Mailchimp, a marketing automation and customer relationship management. The Consumer segment provides TurboTax, a do-it-yourself and assisted income tax preparation products and services; Credit Karma, a personal finance solution that provides recommendations for credit card, home, auto, and personal loan, and insurance products; online savings and checking accounts; and access to its credit scores and reports, credit and identity monitoring, credit report dispute, credit building tools, debt pay-down assistance, credit card rewards optimization, and connected account capabilities. This segment also offers ProTax offerings which include Lacerte, ProSeries, and ProFile desktop tax-preparation software products; and ProConnect Tax Online, electronic tax filing service, and bank products and related services. It sells products and services through direct sales channels, multichannel shop-and-buy experiences, online application stores, and partner and other channels. Intuit Inc. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
